My Sally is a spunky gal
sing Polly wolly doodle all the day
Fare thee well, fare thee well
fare thee well, my fairy fay
for I'm going to Louisiana
for to see my Susyanna
sing Polly wolly doodle all the day

segments.voice: This one is for you.

segments.caption: Lovely!
segments.voice: High five, grown-up. High five, little one.

segments.caption: One more, big finish!
segments.voice: One more time, with a big finish.

segments.caption: Big finish!

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing the same notes with a light, bouncy feel

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the audience; sing 'polly wolly doodle' in your silliest voice, then bow.
classes.childAction: Play light and bouncy for teddy, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: Light fingers bounce like a ball; the chorus waves goodbye with a smile.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song with a bouncy feel.
